title: Dates & Location
description: Dates, venue and audience guide for the April 2012 OpenStack Design Summit and Conference at the Hyatt Regency in San Francisco.
body:
Event Dates

Design Summit

April 16-18, 2012

Working sessions for the developers in the OpenStack community

OpenStack Conference

April 19 & 20th, 2012

Open conference for all OpenStack users and providers: Keynotes, panels, tradeshow and more

Which should you attend?

Everyone: If you are an OpenStack user, provider, researcher, or enthusiast, you'll want to attend the OpenStack Conference held April 19 & 20th. This is the main event and it includes keynotes, panel sessions, and vendor exhibitors who can help you get the most out of OpenStack.

OpenStack Developers: If you are an active developer in the OpenStack community, you'll also want to attend the Design Summit happening right before the conference (April 16-18th). The Design Summit is kept intentionally small so that we can have productive working sessions as we discuss and plan for development on the next release of OpenStack.

The Location

Hyatt Regency Hotel
5 Embarcadero Center, San Francisco, CA 94111
Transit: Market St & Main St

Booking Your Hotel Room

A special rate is available for OpenStack attendees.
